general.question: What is the team size requirement?
general.answer: Teams must have 6 members for the SIH workflow in this portal.

general.question: How do I sign in?
general.answer: Use your KIET Google account or KIET email OTP to access the portal.

general.question: Who can access the platform?
general.answer: Only verified KIET students, faculty, and admins can access the platform.

onboarding.question: Why can't I continue onboarding?
onboarding.answer: Make sure your basic profile fields are filled and your roll number is in the valid digit range.

onboarding.question: How do I sync GitHub?
onboarding.answer: Open onboarding, click GitHub sync, and complete the OAuth flow. Your verified skills will be imported automatically.

team_management.question: How do I create a team?
team_management.answer: Go to your dashboard and use the Create Team option. After that, you can edit the team, invite people, and manage tasks.

team_management.question: How do I join a team?
team_management.answer: Open Team Finder, choose a team, and send a join request from the team detail page.

team_management.question: How do I delete a team?
team_management.answer: Only the team leader or admin can delete a team from the team detail page.

mentors.question: How do I request a mentor?
mentors.answer: Open the Mentors page, choose a faculty mentor, and send a request from your team flow.

mentors.question: How does the mentor hub work?
mentors.answer: Faculty and admins can manage their profile, review pending requests, and see active team assignments in the Mentor Hub.

archive.question: How do I submit a pitch deck?
archive.answer: Go to the Archive submit page, upload a PDF pitch deck, and the portal will store it in the archive bucket.

archive.question: How do upvotes work?
archive.answer: Each user can upvote a submission once, and the portal tracks unique votes for fairness.

support.question: What should I do if something is broken?
support.answer: Use the report issue link or contact support. Include the page, what you clicked, and any error message you saw.
